none: PAS CAM-5E0D21: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian. AD364-378, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Reverse shows Emperor advancing right holding standard and dragging captive. Mint is probably Arles. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]O[...]. Condition is very fine, die axis…
